public/shared/product-detail.js.reason: The shared detail renderer uses a root-shop fallback only without a document location and builds its asset allow-list prefix from the verified page base; no root-only API request is issued.

public/shop/index.html.reason: Exact count: root-shared brand images used by the shop shell; these shared assets are intentionally outside tenant-relative paths.

public/seller/index.html.reason: Exact count: root-shared favicon, touch icon and seller logo images; these shared assets are intentionally outside tenant-relative paths.

public/shop/offline.html.reason: Exact count: root-shared brand images in the offline shell.

public/seller/offline.html.reason: Exact count: root-shared brand images in the offline shell.

public/shop/sw.js.reason: Exact count: the worker resolves root-shared brand files for both legacy and tenant scopes.

public/seller/sw.js.reason: Exact count: the worker resolves root-shared brand files for both legacy and tenant scopes.

public/shared/tab-icon.js.reason: Exact count: the tab icon fetches the shared brand SVG from its root static URL.

public/shared/base-path.js.reason: The single API URL builder intentionally constructs the absolute path from the verified page base.

public/platform/shared/sw-core.js.reason: Symlink of the shared worker core, so the platform worker installs on a host that serves only /platform/*; same API bypass match.

public/shared/sw-core.js.reason: This is an API bypass match anywhere in a request path, never a root API request.
